item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Improved Apache AGE graph query and ingestion performance on Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now includes generally available Apache AGE performance improvements for graph querying and knowledge graph ingestion. The update speeds up eligible read queries through better query planning and graph joins, and improves duplicate detection and memory handling during graph build operations.

  • Source: Azure Updates
